title.en: Emad Mostaque Says Human Ideas Now Add 'Negative Value' as AI Model Releases Accelerate
title.zh: Emad Mostaque Says Human Ideas Now Add 'Negative Value' as AI Model Releases Accelerate

body.en: Mostaque argued that as AI model releases accelerate, purely human-generated ideas are now adding "negative value."
body.zh: Mostaque认为随着AI模型发布速度加快，纯粹由人类产生的想法现在正在带来"负价值"。

title.en: India Stack should become an ‘Intelligence Stack’, says Stability AI co-founder Emad Mostaque
title.zh: India Stack should become an ‘Intelligence Stack’, says Stability AI co-founder Emad Mostaque

body.en: He proposes that India turn India Stack into an 'intelligence stack' giving every citizen an AI agent, his clearest public pitch yet for national open AI infrastructure.
body.zh: 他提议印度把India Stack升级为“智能栈”，让每位公民都拥有自己的AI智能体，这是他迄今对国家级开放AI基础设施最明确的公开主张。

title.en: Emad Mostaque: AI agents will go mainstream this year, reducing friction to boost profitability, and the future of AI lies beyond transformers | Raoul Pal
title.zh: Emad Mostaque: AI agents will go mainstream this year, reducing friction to boost profitability, and the future of AI lies beyond transformers | Raoul Pal

body.en: Mostaque predicted AI agents will go mainstream this year, cutting friction and boosting profitability, and argued the field's future lies beyond transformer architectures.
body.zh: Mostaque预测AI智能体今年将进入主流，降低摩擦并提升盈利能力，并认为该领域的未来将超越Transformer架构。
